item.text:
The system switches at **35°F (about 1.7°C) outdoor temperature**. Below that threshold, the heat pump stops heating and the natural gas furnace takes over.

See Section 1.2.1.5, “Backup System and Switchover Temperature,” in the [ResStock dual fuel heat pump measure documentation](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96414.pdf#page=13).
